fields.english: Impale $1oa Freshwater Crocolisks then return to Tran'jani in Rog'mar.
fields.thai: ปาหอกให้ปักคร็อกโคลิสก์น้ำจืด {world1} ตัว แล้วกลับไปหา Tran'jani ที่ Rog'mar

source_record.description:
You got de spears, now ya gonna learn how to throw dem.

De Riverglades be full o' crocolisks. Nasty tings. Snap you up if ya ain't quick. Perfect for target practice, heheh.

Go stick yourself a bunch of dem. Den you come back to ol' Tran'jani for ya prize. If ya can stick a crocolisk, ya can stick any'ting.
source_record.objectivesText: Impale $1oa Freshwater Crocolisks then return to Tran'jani in Rog'mar.
source_record.title: Stick 'Em

fields.english: Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.
fields.thai: ขุดชิ้นส่วนสมบัติ Highborne {world1} ชิ้นด้วยเกรียงขุดสมบัติ 3000 ให้ Izvi Glidfizz ที่ Valormok

source_record.description:
What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!
source_record.objectivesText: Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.
source_record.title: Long Walks on the Beach

fields.english: Bring $1oa Redstone Basilisk Scales to Bernie Heisten.
fields.thai: นำเกล็ด Redstone Basilisk {world1} ชิ้นไปให้ Bernie Heisten

source_record.description:
You may have seen the Redstone basilisks wandering the wastes outside while you were on your way to Nethergarde Keep. They're tough creatures, well adapted to survival in the Blasted Lands. One of their key qualities is their sturdy scales, which reflect heat, protect against sand and wind, and even deflect weapon blows!

They're a perfect material for making shields, and if you can bring me a bundle, I'll compensate you well. Only bring ones in good condition!
source_record.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Redstone Basilisk Scales to Bernie Heisten.
source_record.title: Deflective Surface

fields.english: Kill $1oa Blood Elf Reclaimers and $2oa Blood Elf Surveyors, then find the source of Rimtori's power.
fields.thai: สังหาร Blood Elf Reclaimers {world1} คน และ Blood Elf Surveyors {world2} คน แล้วค้นหาต้นตอพลังของ Rimtori

source_record.description:
This camp used to be a dozen warriors strong, $n. Now, they are all dead.

That mage, Rimtori, has slain them all. She played Belgrom like a lute; claiming Azshara would hold great riches... powerful items.

Belgrom sent us to protect her, and said we would be rewarded. Well, look who's the fool--we were slaughtered.

The blood elves are camped along the southern bluffs on the northern peninsula. Kill every one you see. Then, find the source of Rimtori's power so we can exact our revenge.
source_record.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Blood Elf Reclaimers and $2oa Blood Elf Surveyors, then find the source of Rimtori's power.
source_record.title: Betrayed

fields.english: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa  Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.
fields.thai: เข้า Alcaz Prison แล้วสังหารทหาร Strashaz {world1} นายกับนางมนตรา Strashaz {world2} ตน จากนั้นนำหัวของ Tidemistress Ca'zass ไปให้ Sully McCleary

source_record.description:
Was spyin' on the shore of Alcaz with my trusty lookin' glass whilst you were off eavesdroppin' on Lady Proudmoore. I think the island may be under attack. I saw naga--lots of them, chargin' onto shore. 

The enemy of my enemy is certainly not my friend when it comes to naga, so let's do the world a favor and take some of them out. I also spied what looks to be the leader--a spellcaster type barkin' orders. Take her out as well, if you can.
source_record.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa  Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.
source_record.title: A Bit of Wet Work
